title: Referral invite
description: Full-viewport referral screen composing the form-layout block: what the referral gives in three steps, then a form for friends' email addresses and an optional note, with a success alert naming the addresses the last send reached and the form's error, loading and disabled states. Presentational — data and callbacks in, no navigation state — and responsive to its container (@container) across the @sm and @md contract steps: the masthead lines up at @sm, the title grows, the steps sit side by side and the footer lines up at @md.
